title: #Poemsofpresence Poetry in stone stanzas stacked sideways cadence in bricks which fit in precision and measure junctions of joints to join in concise
summary: #Poemsofpresence Poetry in stone stanzas stacked sideways cadence in bricks which fit in precision and measure junctions of joints to join in concise points to support the hyperbole of carved keystone hubris built on beds aggregate anchors in lines of human experience
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#Poemsofpresence
Poetry in stone
  stanzas stacked
sideways
  cadence in
bricks which
  fit in
precision and
  measure
junctions of
   joints to
join in concise
  points
to support the
  hyperbole of
carved keystone
  hubris
built on beds
aggregate anchors
in lines of human
experience
